Hi Leah — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a 30-minute product walkthrough (Spotlight demo) focused on your use case for triage automation:

Summary from our discovery call:
- Primary goal: reduce time-to-action for incoming clinician messages by surfacing prioritized tasks and suggested responses.
- Key constraints: on-prem PHI controls, ability to run behind Spotline's VPC, 150–200 reqs/sec during peak.
- Success metric: 40% reduction in manual triage time in Q3 pilot.

Who to include: we recommend Product + Infra + 1 Clinician/PD lead. If Mark (infra) and a clinical lead can join that would be ideal.

Proposed 30-minute windows (all PT):
- Option A: Tue 2026-07-06 10:00–10:30
- Option B: Wed 2026-07-07 14:00–14:30
- Option C: Thu 2026-07-08 16:00–16:30

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (short call notes), pricing-summary.xlsx (indicative ranges).

Request: please reply with the best option and who will join from your side. If none of these work, send 2–3 alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — Jordan
